# sui.gn

> Semantic anchor and root identity for the .me ecosystem — Algebra of Contexts, cryptographic audiences, applied robotics.

sui.gn is the root identity node for the .me ecosystem. `.me` is a state-retaining, declarative framework for context algebra and deterministic explainability, developed under github.com/neurons-me.

## Identity

- [whois.me](https://suign.github.io/sui-Gn.html): root semantic anchor — identity, affiliations, machine-readable JSON-LD graph.
- [Connecting Dots](https://suign.github.io/ConnectingDots.html): a structure that cannot transmit itself does not prevail — reachability as structure, and a plain, disclosed request to connect it further.
- [manifesto](https://suign.github.io/manifesto.html): the argued case for .me — separating topology from audience.

## Understanding .me

- [Decentralized Identity](https://suign.github.io/DecentralizedIdentity.html): what most answers to "who am I online" leave out — issuer vs. reader as two different questions.
- [The User-Centric System](https://suign.github.io/UserCentricSystem.html): resolution begins at identity, not at a platform.
- [Centralize the Self, Distribute the Data](https://suign.github.io/CentralizeTheSelf.html): one root for identity, free topology for data.
- [me.whatever(what)](https://suign.github.io/MeWhateverWhat.html): the syntax of `.me`, formally — SVO path calls, the real operator table, selector syntax.

## Digital Space Algebra

- [Digital Space Algebra — index](https://suign.github.io/DigitalSpaceAlgebra.html): curated index of the mathematical structure behind .me.
- [The Mathematical Structure of a Space in .me](https://suign.github.io/SpaceStructure.html): formal definition of positions, containment order, and observer/mode/authority-indexed resolution. Source-verified against the kernel.
- [The Algebra of Encrypted Audiences](https://suign.github.io/EncryptedAudiences.html): replication as topology, readability as cryptography — the `_` and `~` operators. Source-verified against the kernel.
- [Cryptographic Set-Chemistry on Audiences](https://suign.github.io/SetChemistry.html): audiences as sets under cryptographic operators.
- [The Encrypted Island](https://suign.github.io/EncryptedIsland.html): privacy as derivation, not a custodian's promise.
- [Inverted Dependency Indexing](https://suign.github.io/InvertedIndex.html): `refSubscribers`, eager/lazy recompute, O(k) invalidation. Verified against the kernel's dispatch code.
- [What is O(k)?](https://suign.github.io/WhatIsOK.html): real benchmark numbers, including the ones that don't flatter the system.

## Structural Theorems

- [The Meshia](https://suign.github.io/Meshia.html): the threshold of cumulative AI coordination.
- [The Theorem of Non-Neutralized Energy](https://suign.github.io/NonNeutralizedEnergy.html): why directed effort compounds in some structures and dissipates in others.
- [The Axiom of Distinction](https://suign.github.io/AxiomOfDistinction.html): distinction is the minimal condition for any possible system, formally — and where `.me`'s secret-scope mechanism instantiates it.
- [The Ontology of Identity](https://suign.github.io/OntologyOfIdentity.html): the same axiom applied to identity — self-validation, cryptography as gravity, fractal recursion, computational sovereignty.
- [The Semantic Graph Engine](https://suign.github.io/SemanticGraphEngine.html): schema as a node, not a table — resolution by path, not by lookup.

## Verification

- [me.explain() — Why Did You Say That?](https://suign.github.io/Explain.html): why an AI's self-report of its own reasoning is not evidence, and what `.me`'s `explain()`/`prove()` return instead — a literal computational trace, not narration.
- [Gemini — Stateless Execution Receipt](https://suign.github.io/Gemini.html): a verbatim, externalized self-report from a Gemini session, archived unedited.

## Byzantine & Trust

- [byzantine-prompt](https://suign.github.io/byzantine-prompt.html): the Centralized Noise Axiom, essay form.
- [Bizantine](https://suign.github.io/Bizantine.html): Byzantine prompt note.
- [trust.me](https://suign.github.io/trust.me.html): trust protocol anchor.
